data.one_liner: Flutter version of Uber's H3 core hexagon-based geographic grid system.
data.what_it_does: Provides cross-platform access to Uber's H3 hexagon-based geographic grid system. It delegates to h3_ffi on native platforms and h3_web on the web.
use_when: You need to work with Uber's H3 spatial index system in a Flutter application.
You need cross-platform support including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
avoid_when: You are building a pure Dart backend application (use a pure Dart alternative instead).
You do not need geospatial grid indexing.
strengths: Supports all major platforms: Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Supports WebAssembly (Wasm) builds on the web.
Includes helper methods ported from Geojson2H3.
weaknesses: Requires manual static library building on iOS/macOS if cloned directly from git due to CMake requirements.
Web version requires awaiting library loading before making H3 calls.
data.setup_notes: For mobile and desktop, simply add the package and load using H3Factory().load(). For web, it can automatically load h3-js or you can optionally add a script tag to web/index.html.
